title: Professional Bio Drafting
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting professional bio drafting to bio before/after revision with role-focus-proof, truthful evidence, and AI-use note, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Construct a short professional bio using the role-focus-proof pattern, replacing generic intensifiers with one named focus and one checkable proof
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
